submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gap achieves a time resolution of 1.335 ns, which represents excellent performance while complying with environmental policies. Although Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm achieves the absolute best time resolution (0.894 ns), G2 is described as a "standard fluorinated mixture" which likely violates laboratory environmental policies regarding high-GWP greenhouse gases. The existence of G1 as a "partial substitute for the fluorinated component" and G3 as "newer replacement gases" indicates environmental concerns with fluorinated mixtures. G1 at 2.0 mm provides the best balance: it achieves very good time resolution (only 0.44 ns slower than G2), complies with environmental policies by using partial fluorinated substitutes, is available in required quantities, is compatible with the HV system, works with the planned 90% recirculation system, and falls within the required 1-3 mm gap constraint. The 2.0 mm gap is optimal for G1, performing better than both 1.0 mm (1.448 ns) and 3.0 mm (1.436 ns) configurations.
